passives.name: Final Destination
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Recovers [Buff_V_tower_hard_mob_30_14] Weakness Gauge every turn. Increases damage taken from Light/Dark elements, but increases damage dealt to Earth/Water/Fire elements and reduces damage taken from them. Increases damage dealt by all attacks when the caster has a buff.

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker is Fire
−50% damage to boss if attacker is Water
−50% damage to boss if attacker is Earth
+30% damage to boss if attacker is Light
+30% damage to boss if attacker is Dark
